preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in [n, m, k]) and n >= 2 and m >= 1 and k >= 2 and m * k <= n
preconditions.description: Input integers n (array length), m (beauty constant), and k (number of subarrays) satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 2e5, 1 ≤ m, 2 ≤ k, and m·k ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in a) and all(-1e9 <= x <= 1e9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The array a has exactly n elements, each an integer between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: Output consists of two lines: the first line is the maximum possible sum of beauties (max_sum) as a string, and the second line is k-1 split points (split_points) as space-separated integers, where 1 ≤ split_points[0] < split_points[1] < ... < split_points[k-2] < n.

postconditions.expression: max_sum == sum(sum(sorted(subarray, reverse=True)[:m]) for subarray in partition(a, split_points))
postconditions.description: max_sum equals the sum of beauties of the k subarrays defined by split_points, where beauty is the sum of the m largest elements in each subarray.

postconditions.expression: len(split_points) == k - 1 and all(1 <= p < n for p in split_points) and all(p1 < p2 for p1, p2 in zip(split_points, split_points[1:]))
postconditions.description: split_points contains exactly k-1 integers, each between 1 and n-1, strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subarray) >= m for subarray in partition(a, split_points))
postconditions.description: Every subarray in the partition has at least m elements.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subarray) > 0 for subarray in partition(a, split_points)) and sum(len(subarray) for subarray in partition(a, split_points)) == n
postconditions.description: The partition covers all elements of a exactly once, with no empty subarrays.
